ns2:course.label: Optimization in Networks
ns2:course.description: Theory and methods for optimization over directed graphs; paths, cuts, flows, and potentials; matchings; PERT and CPM; max flow, min path, out-of-kilter, Hungarian, and other algorithms; nonlinear cost functionals; painting theory; and existence and duality. Prerequisite: MATH 242 or MATH 243.
